14940218-0b7a-445a-8352-8de016f0c597.data: Mitosis has five phases: Interphase, Prophase, Metaphase, Anaphase, and Telophase.
14940218-0b7a-445a-8352-8de016f0c597.text_lemmatized: Mitosis has five phases: Interphase, Prophase, Metaphase, Anaphase, and Telophase.

3e12fb36-039d-4759-a47c-8b8b796d24fb.data: During Interphase, the DNA in the cell is copied in preparation for cell division, resulting in two identical complete sets of chromosomes.
3e12fb36-039d-4759-a47c-8b8b796d24fb.text_lemmatized: During Interphase, the DNA in the cell is copied in preparation for cell division, resulting in two identical complete sets of chromosomes.

ad9c2903-3b44-4c05-8903-f923a49eb0f9.data: In Prophase, chromosomes condense into X-shaped structures that can be easily seen under a microscope, and the membrane around the nucleus dissolves away releasing the chromosomes.
ad9c2903-3b44-4c05-8903-f923a49eb0f9.text_lemmatized: In Prophase, chromosomes condense into X-shaped structures that can be easily seen under a microscope, and the membrane around the nucleus dissolves away releasing the chromosomes.

dbd48ef2-53fd-43d7-b1d5-d9294a2bccda.data: During Metaphase, the chromosomes line up neatly end-to-end along the center of the cell, and the mitotic spindle fibers attach to each of the sister chromatids.
dbd48ef2-53fd-43d7-b1d5-d9294a2bccda.text_lemmatized: During Metaphase, the chromosomes line up neatly end-to-end along the center of the cell, and the mitotic spindle fibers attach to each of the sister chromatids.

93524ee7-c80f-4fea-8411-86f7bc6cce14.data: In Anaphase, the sister chromatids are pulled apart by the mitotic spindle, which pulls one chromatid to one pole and the other chromatid to the opposite pole.
93524ee7-c80f-4fea-8411-86f7bc6cce14.text_lemmatized: In Anaphase, the sister chromatids are pulled apart by the mitotic spindle, which pulls one chromatid to one pole and the other chromatid to the opposite pole.

9bb0aa32-fa4f-405b-883a-8a6e3dcad808.data: In Telophase, a full set of chromosomes gather together at each pole of the cell, and a membrane forms around each set of chromosomes to create two new nuclei.
9bb0aa32-fa4f-405b-883a-8a6e3dcad808.text_lemmatized: In Telophase, a full set of chromosomes gather together at each pole of the cell, and a membrane forms around each set of chromosomes to create two new nuclei.
